what: The search in the proof of Theorem 8.2. Every split of every graph in TO1 is one of these 7,006 graphs up to isomorphism, and each of them is a split of a graph in TO1. Each graph is given as produced by its split: the vertex split, the new vertex, and the neighbours moved to it; contracting the edge between them gives the graph it was split from. Verdicts: kept (a certificate that it has no K5 minor, made of planar pieces and copies of V8 glued along cliques of order at most three, and a torus embedding of every edge deletion), K5 minor (branch sets), or an edge deletion containing some T_i as a minor (the edge and a minor model, vertex numbers of T_i as in O1). No genus computation is used.
